title: Mail Triage Extension
description: Schema for the Graph Open Extension written by CPMForge.M365 case lifecycle activities. triage, evidence, and processingFlags are JSON-serialized strings on the wire — Graph open extensions do not reliably support nested objects on personal MSA accounts.

caseId.title: Case ID
caseId.description: Unique case identifier, auto-generated by InitializeCase as C + base36(DateTime.UtcNow.Ticks).

caseStatus.title: Case Status
caseStatus.description: Coarse lifecycle state of the Email Case. Owned by the Dispatcher (initial) and Aggregator (updates). In the 1:1 pattern the Performer may update directly via UpdateCase.

stateVersion.title: State Version
stateVersion.description: Monotonically incrementing integer string. Starts at '1', incremented by UpdateCase on each write.

triage.title: Triage
triage.description: JSON-serialized triage object. Written once by InitializeCase; not updated by UpdateCase.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: JSON-serialized evidence profile. Auto-filled from the MailMessage by InitializeCase; UpdateCase can merge additional keys.

processingFlags.title: Processing Flags
processingFlags.description: JSON-serialized array of flag entries written by the Performer via FlagMessage when a non-happy-path condition is detected. Append-only; cleared only at case closure.

evidenceObject.title: Evidence
evidenceObject.description: Evidence profile derived from the MailMessage. Additional properties allowed — Dispatcher or Performer may write arbitrary keys.

hasBodyInstruction.title: Has Body Instruction
hasBodyInstruction.description: True when the message body contains content.

evidenceSummary.title: Evidence Summary
evidenceSummary.description: Auto-generated human-readable summary, e.g. '2 PDF, 1 Excel attachment(s); body has content'.

note.title: Note
note.description: Optional free-text detail written by the Performer.
